level2.title: Loaves and Fishes
level2.story: When Jesus heard John the Baptist had died, He went to a quiet place, but crowds followed Him. He felt pity for them and healed their sick. In the evening the disciples said, "Send them away to buy food." Jesus said, "Give them some food yourselves," but they had only five loaves and two fish. Jesus looked up to heaven, blessed and broke the loaves, and all ate and were satisfied, with twelve baskets left over.
level2.keyLine: They did all eat, and were filled.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is this miracle like the Mass?
What small thing can you give Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, take what I have and make it more. Amen.
